locks.title: Locked-sources gate
locks.empty: locked list is empty (zero-value guard: an empty assertion surface is not a pass)
locks.sha_mismatch: %(name)s: sha256 mismatch (declared %(declared)s… measured %(actual)s…) — upstream bytes drifted
locks.no_sha256: %(name)s: file-form entry has no sha256 (that is not pinning)
locks.entry_missing_field: locked entry missing field %(field)s: %(entry)r (an unexplained lock is a zombie)
locks.absent_optional: %(name)s: absent on this machine (optional ⇒ stated, not a pass)
locks.off: off (%(name)s does not exist ⇒ says so and exits 0; pluggable)
locks.explicit_spec_missing: explicitly specified spec %(name)s does not exist (--spec) — write it or drop the flag
